This article makes no claim identifying any individual glyph in that sequence: its graphic account is supported by the independently cited profile-person analysis (X-ea0a6454b274412a195e, X-0b67e7f34e2a8164e285) and the book’s readable prose about two early variants (X-66ca071418375a11b542).
